activities.name: Walking
activities.description: A flexible outdoor or indoor movement activity.

activities.name: Gentle mobility and stretching
activities.description: A short movement and flexibility break.

activities.name: Leisurely cycling
activities.description: A cycling activity at a comfortable pace.

activities.name: Beginner bodyweight movement
activities.description: Simple bodyweight movements with options to pause or reduce effort.

activities.name: Recreational dancing
activities.description: Enjoyable movement to music at a self-selected pace.

rules.name: Time budget
rules.statement: Planned activity duration must not exceed the user's available minutes.

rules.name: No schedule overlap
rules.statement: An activity must fit completely inside a free time window and cannot overlap a busy block.

rules.name: Preference ranking
rules.statement: Prefer activities selected by the user or tagged for their stated goal.

rules.name: Non-clinical scope
rules.statement: The system provides general activity planning, not diagnosis or treatment.

rules.name: Grounded explanation
rules.statement: The language model may explain only facts supplied by the activity library and validated plan.
